title: Scaffold Hum Qadam application (backend + frontend)
description: Build the initial application scaffold based on the completed planning artifacts (plan/, CLAUDE.md, decisions.md, .claude/skills, .claude/agents). Backend: Node.js/Express API + conversation state machine + AI service (Claude prompts from plan/09) + WhatsApp integration layer + Supabase-backed schema from plan/10, enforcing CLAUDE.md hard rules (six-component plans, resource constraints, weekday/holiday messaging, Stop/Start pause, coach-only data access). Frontend: React/Vite coach dashboard per plan/14 (Overview, Teacher List, Teacher Detail, Analytics, Reports).
acceptance_criteria: backend/ and frontend/ directories exist with working package.json, clean modular structure, core logic for the six-component plan validator and WhatsApp message formatting rules actually implemented (not just stubbed), dashboard pages scaffolded and wired to a documented API contract, README in each explaining setup and what's stubbed vs real.
close_reason: Backend and frontend scaffolded per plan/, CLAUDE.md, decisions.md; verified with passing unit tests, a clean frontend build, and a real backend boot test (fixed a Supabase-client crash-on-missing-env bug found during that verification).
